why_ai: Campaign planning and data processing are screen work that AI-native mail platforms can absorb, while printed pieces, lettershops and door-to-door walkers keep part of the value physical.
why_clarity: Mail files, postal rules and response rates are exact and checkable, but circulation strategy runs on feel and matchback reads arrive months later.
why_digital: Lists and data in and screen-based planning, but the customer receives a physical mailpiece or door hanger, and door-to-door work is bought locally.

why_ai: FCRA prescreen rules add some accountability, but selection and test design are model-driven work issuers can bring in-house or automate.
why_clarity: Booked, activated accounts per piece are an exact target across thousands of near-identical waves, read only after activation matures.
why_digital: Bureau data and models in, analysis on screens, physical mailpieces out, bought by national issuers from remote agencies.

why_ai: Nonprofits keep agencies that know their donors and voice, and mail stays central for older donors, though analytics and production are automatable.
why_clarity: Net revenue per appeal is measurable and appeals recur monthly, but acquisition and housefile logic differ and lifetime value takes years.
why_digital: Donor data in and screen-based planning, physical appeals out, with agencies hired remotely by national charities.

why_ai: Pooled co-op data and modelling protect the leaders, but selection is model work AI can extend.
why_clarity: Cost per donor is exact and campaigns repeat, but the outcome that matters, a second gift, arrives a year or more later.
why_digital: Co-op and list data in, models on screens, physical acquisition packages out, bought remotely.

why_ai: Knowledge of a nonprofit's donors and tone keeps the relationship, though per-donor ask decisions are automatable.
why_clarity: Appeals to the same donors recur many times a year with measurable gifts, while ask-string rules are folklore rather than method.
why_digital: The nonprofit's own giving data in, decisions on screens, physical appeals out.

why_ai: Walkers hanging pieces on doors in unstructured neighbourhoods is hands-on work no software performs, though it carries no licence or judgement premium.
why_clarity: Doors covered is an exact, repeated measure, but dumped bundles surface only weeks later when response collapses.
why_digital: Physical pieces delivered by hand to physical doors, sold by local firms to local clients.

why_ai: Partisan trust, disclaimer law and adversarial, one-shot persuasion decisions protect the consultant, and campaigns will keep paying for mail.
why_clarity: Programmes repeat in shape, but whether a piece moved votes is judged once, on election night, and rarely isolated.
why_digital: Voter files and models in, design on screens, physical pieces out, with consultants hired through partisan networks.

why_ai: Route selection and templated postcards are routine work online EDDM tools already automate, protected only by local relationships.
why_clarity: Routes, counts and booked jobs are exact and monthly drops repeat, though attribution needs the owner's job records.
why_digital: Route data and templates in, physical postcards out, sold to local owners by local printers and online services.

why_ai: Templated monthly postcards are automatable; the agent's local reputation, not the mail vendor, carries the trust.
why_clarity: The same farm is mailed monthly, but listings won show up years later at a low base rate.
why_digital: Farm lists and templates online, physical postcards out, bought remotely by agents.

why_ai: Merge/purge, CASS and NCOA processing are rule-bound data operations, protected only partly by postal compliance responsibility.
why_clarity: Duplicates, suppressions, Move Update and net-name counts follow exact rules on thousands of near-identical jobs.
why_digital: List files in, processed mail files out, all digital, bought by agencies and mailers remotely.

why_ai: Record linkage and roll-up reporting are mechanical analytics that software and AI already perform.
why_clarity: The same matchback recurs per campaign with exact matches, while incrementality stays debated without holdouts.
why_digital: Order and mail files in, digital reports out, delivered remotely.

why_ai: A pooled multi-brand transaction corpus protects the co-ops, though modelling itself is increasingly automated and privacy law constrains supply.
why_clarity: Modelled selections recur per campaign and are scored by later purchases, read over the response window.
why_digital: Contributed transaction data in, models and name files out, sold to members remotely.

why_ai: Partisan trust and voter-file use rules protect vendors, and campaigns will keep buying targeting each cycle.
why_clarity: File builds and scores repeat by cycle and can be checked against recorded turnout after each election.
why_digital: Public voter files and commercial data in, enhanced files and scores out, sold remotely within partisan networks.

why_ai: A decades-long archive of panel-collected mail protects the providers, though coding pieces is automatable.
why_clarity: Each piece is coded to a fixed schema at volume, while volume and spend estimates are hard to verify.
why_digital: Physical mailpieces scanned and coded into a database delivered online to subscribers.

why_ai: Broker relationships with list owners and mailers carry the business, though list recommendation is pattern work AI can assist.
why_clarity: Recommendations repeat by campaign, but their quality is judged loosely through continuation orders.
why_digital: Datacards and order histories in, recommendations and orders out, all remote.

why_ai: Client relationships and fundraising judgement give some protection, but segmentation and reporting are automatable analytics.
why_clarity: Campaign results are measurable and recur monthly, with lifetime outcomes slower to read.
why_digital: Client donor data in, models and reports out, delivered remotely.

why_ai: Statutory authority over mail preparation and pricing keeps the function in human, accountable hands, and it persists by law.
why_clarity: Preparation standards are exact and applied to every mailing, while price decisions are contested in regulatory review.
why_digital: eDoc and scan data in, rules, scorecards and assessments out, with some physical acceptance checks.

why_ai: Turning scan feeds into dashboards is routine data processing that USPS tools and platforms increasingly provide directly.
why_clarity: Scan events and delivery timing are objective and recur for every campaign.
why_digital: Postal scan data in, digital reports out, sold remotely.

why_ai: Statistical expertise and client trust help, but response modelling is increasingly automated by platforms and co-ops.
why_clarity: Models are scored on holdout performance and campaigns repeat, though results arrive over the response window.
why_digital: Client files in, models and recommendations out, delivered remotely.

why_ai: Bundled with large production relationships, the analytics are protected by the contract more than the work.
why_clarity: Audience models and reports recur per campaign with measurable response.
why_digital: Client data in, analysis on screens, delivered within print and postal services to national mailers.

why_ai: Weekly physical distribution to most households keeps the core physical, while redemption analytics are automatable.
why_clarity: Distribution zones, counts and redemptions are exact and repeat every week.
why_digital: Advertisers' circulars and coupons in, physical packages delivered, with redemption data processed digitally.

why_ai: Print-and-mail by API is software orchestration over partner printers; little protects it beyond operations and USPS integration.
why_clarity: Each job is an exact specification with tracking and delivery status.
why_digital: API calls and files in, physical mail produced by partners, sold entirely online.

why_ai: USPS certification gives some protection, but rule-bound presort logic is exactly what software does.
why_clarity: Presort and barcode rules are exact and certified, with instant pass or fail at acceptance.
why_digital: Software sold and delivered digitally to mailers nationwide.

why_ai: Advocacy before the Postal Service and regulator rests on relationships and judgement, and members will keep funding it.
why_clarity: Policy outcomes are negotiated and seldom attributable to any single filing.
why_digital: Filings and briefings produced on screens, with in-person regulatory and member meetings.

why_ai: Selling and managing subcontracted walkers ties the network to physical delivery, though its own staff work on screens.
why_clarity: Campaigns repeat with countable doors, verified only through GPS and complaints.
why_digital: Client campaigns in, physical distribution through local crews, sold nationally and remotely.

why_ai: Contributed programme data gives the studies credibility, though compiling benchmarks is routine analysis.
why_clarity: The same metrics are computed every year from contributed results.
why_digital: Contributed data in, published reports out, all online.

why_ai: Sellers pay a trusted adviser for buyer relationships and a negotiated price.
why_clarity: Each sale is a bespoke negotiation, with the outcome known when the deal closes.
why_digital: Valuation is desk work, but deals rely on meetings and introductions.
